name: Corner ledger
oneLiner: running notes in the top corners while the speaker weighs two options: a glass slab drops into the left corner with an underlined heading and grows a line per beat, the right corner follows, then a green check lands on the chosen side and the other steps back
say: when the speaker walks through two options and their points in turn ('you can buy outright: you own it, it's cheaper long term; or you finance...'): one line lands per point as it's said; pick lands the check on the one they recommend, empty pick just lists; b empty for a single running list
